name: close-button
description: The close button is used inside of other components, like a toast or an action bar, for closing or dismissing its parent component.

documentBlocks.content: The close button is used inside of other components, like a toast or an action bar, for closing or dismissing its parent component.

Keyboard focus.

A close button can be navigated using a keyboard. The keyboard focus state takes the close button's visual hover state and adds a ring to the button in focus.
Don't use close buttons for delete actions
documentBlocks.dont: A close button is only for dismissing or closing its parent component, not for taking a destructive action (like deleting a file). Use an action button instead.

documentBlocks.content:
Keyboard interactions.

Key Interaction TabMoves focus onto or off of the close button.Space or EnterExecutes the button (closes or dismisses the parent component). Focus moves to the target or back to the caller.

Cursor guidelines.

Cursor Description PointerUse the pointer cursor for all interactive components in every state.
